name: Cervical Dystonia / Spasmodic Torticollis
definition: Focal dystonia causing involuntary patterned contractions of neck muscles, producing abnormal head posture, tremor and pain.

redFlags.item: Drug-induced acute dystonia with airway involvement

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is clinical; imaging is selective for atypical or secondary cases.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, inflammatory, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Oral medications or surgery are specialist options for selected patients.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Greeva-stambha/Kampa phenotype may be documented only as a parallel framework.

patientEducation.summary: Focal dystonia causing involuntary patterned contractions of neck muscles, producing abnormal head posture, tremor and pain.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.

sources.title: Botulinum Neurotoxin for Movement Disorders guidance
